parts.text: Create ONE entirely original premium character design for a happy, thoughtful personal AI teammate. SUBJECT: a living finely woven bookmark-ribbon character, tall slender flexible silhouette that curls softly at the top like a quiff and sweeps into a loop at its lower end, forest-green woven front with warm ivory reverse and restrained gold edging. Tiny mitten-like helpful hands emerging naturally from the woven sides, expressive friendly eyes embedded in a sculpted folded face near upper end and a cheerful small smile. One hand waves, the other offers an open palm. Premium textile puppet with complex beautiful weave and soft material folds, not a flat strip with pasted eyes. Full body in a balanced front three-quarter view, entire head, limbs, wings and tail fully visible, body occupies about 65 percent of square canvas with generous clean margins. Warm inviting expression and intelligent expressive face, aesthetically beautiful and emotionally engaging, adult-friendly rather than babyish. Each material must look convincingly tactile and meticulously crafted: a premium animated feature character / designer art-toy level of finish. Forest green, warm cream and sage mint with restrained honey/amber or muted apricot accents; harmonious, not dull monochrome. Soft cinematic studio lighting, fine controlled highlights, deep material detail. Plain perfectly uniform light gray backdrop, no floor shadow, no cast shadows, no platform, no scenery, no additional props or objects, no floating particles. NO WORDS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. One character only. Do not imitate any existing branded mascot, no human likeness, no generic helmet robot, no simple ball with eyes. Square character development master.
